A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SiReRAG work. Their main text, tables, equations, figures, and complete appendices are readable, including the image-based prompts, and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original clustering analyses, QA experiments, ablations, and efficiency measurements in the main text and appendices, including Tables 1–11.

after.justification: v2 retains the original empirical studies and reports revised supplementary QA scores in Table 11.

M1.justification: The reported proposition-extraction prompt changes from producing facts with entity lists in v1 Figure 7 to facts with semantic triplets in v2 Figure 8, requiring at least one triplet entity to appear in the supplied entity list. The dual-tree indexing design remains unchanged. Separate entity extraction was already described in v1; its newly displayed prompt is additional documentation.

E1.justification: Both versions retain BAAI/IndustryCorpus for extraction-model training, the three main multihop QA datasets, QuALITY, and the supplementary single-hop MuSiQue, MultiHop-RAG, and ASQA evaluations. Table 11 revisions do not introduce new task coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: RAPTOR, HippoRAG, and GraphRAG in Table 4; the BM25 and ColBERTv2 comparisons in Table 6; closed-book and self-ask comparisons in Table 9; and RAPTOR in Table 11.

E3.justification: Reported evaluation settings remain unchanged, including 1,000 questions per main dataset, 502 single-hop questions, 700 MultiHop-RAG questions, and 948 ASQA questions. Metrics, retrieval counts, and model choices are retained. Appendix F newly discloses GraphRAG settings without stating that an earlier setting was changed.

E4.justification: The clustering-coverage analysis, hierarchical-chunk experiment, component ablations, cross-tree comparison, compatibility studies, efficiency analyses, and qualitative tree example are retained. Table 11 changes benchmark values without introducing or redesigning an analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report five runs with means and standard deviations for the QuALITY experiment in Table 2. No repeated-run information, uncertainty reporting practice, or statistical test is added or revised elsewhere.

E6.justification: Table 11 substantially revises both methods' absolute EM/F1 scores. Single-hop F1 changes from 40.50 to 80.67 for RAPTOR and 41.49 to 82.64 for SiReRAG; MultiHop-RAG F1 changes from 60.46 to 86.37 and 61.89 to 88.41, respectively. ASQA scores, Tables 1–10, and method rankings remain unchanged. The stated settings are retained, but the PDFs do not explain these large numerical revisions.

T1.justification: The similarity/relatedness definitions, shared-entity assumption, clustering-coverage reasoning, and TPER definition in Equation 1 are unchanged. No theorem, proof, or substantive mathematical derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contribution: combining similarity and relatedness for RAG indexing. Claims of approximately 1.9% average F1 improvement over indexing baselines and up to 7.8% improvement with existing retrieval methods are retained.

C2.justification: Section 6.1 softens its applicability judgment of GraphRAG from 'not a competitive method' to 'not the most competitive approach' for multihop QA. This is a limited qualification; the explanations of GraphRAG's behavior, SiReRAG's mechanisms, efficiency, and reasoning-hop effects otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and repository link. New Appendix F documents GraphRAG auto-tuning, domain-adapted prompts, mostly default hyperparameters, a short response type, and omission of covariates. It also supplies the previously undisplayed entity/type-extraction prompt and revises the proposition prompt.

R1.justification: The cited research works and central novelty positioning against similarity-only and relatedness-only indexing remain unchanged. The added GraphRAG documentation link provides implementation guidance rather than expanding the related-work discussion.

P1.justification: Section 4.2 rewrites the extraction workflow more clearly, and several sentences receive small wording or grammar edits. A new GraphRAG appendix shifts the prompts appendix from F to G, and conference-publication headers are added. The overall narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds an entity-extraction Figure 7 and replaces the former raster proposition prompt with a revised typeset Figure 8. Table 11 moves from page 16 to page 17 alongside Figure 5, and running headers are added. The main diagrams and table structures are preserved.

improvement.justification: The added code-access information, GraphRAG configuration, explicit entity-extraction prompt, and clearer workflow explanation provide a limited improvement in reproducibility and clarity. The main empirical support remains unchanged. The unexplained Table 11 revisions and absence of evidence isolating the prompt change prevent treating the higher scores as demonstrated methodological progress.
